theorem_title: Stored cover keys survive a protected-prefix update
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightCoverKeyData.Stored.of_kept {μ ν : ℕ → ℤ} {free h J : ℕ} (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightCoverKeyData.Stored μ free h J)
    (K : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Kept μ ν (_root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightCoverKeyData.keyEnd free h J)) : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightCoverKeyData.Stored ν free h J := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
If $\mu$ stores cover-key data at free base $f$ for dimensions $h,J$ and $\nu$ agrees with $\mu$ below the exact key-end address, the same stored cover-key data hold in $\nu$.

This transport retains the constructed cover and global output keys while later wanted and source storage is allocated.
